definition.def: If people promote something, they help or encourage it to happen, increase, or spread.
examples: You don't have to sacrifice environmental protection to promote economic growth. [VERB noun]
We actively promote the use of alternative transport methods. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If a firm promotes a product, it tries to increase the sales or popularity of that product.
examples: The singer has announced a full British tour to promote his second solo album. [VERB noun]
...a special St Lucia week where the island could be promoted as a tourist destination. [be VERB-ed + as]

definition.def: If someone is promoted, they are given a more important job or rank in the organization that they work for.
examples: I was promoted to editor and then editorial director. [be V-ed + from/to]
In fact, those people have been promoted. [be VERB-ed]

definition.def: If a team that competes in a league is promoted, it starts competing in a higher division in the next season because it was one of the most successful teams in the lower division. [British]
examples: They won the Second Division title and were promoted to the First Division. [be VERB-ed + to]
